title: Day After Talks In Delhi, Iran Says It Wants To "Turn The Page" With UAE
summary_full: "We had a constructive exchange with the crown prince of Abu Dhabi," Masoud Pezeshkian said a day after a meeting with Sheikh Khaled Bin Mohamed Bin Zayed Al Nahyan in India, on the sidelines of the BRICS summit.
